html:
The first warm weekend in March has a way of showing every smudge on the windows. Sunlight comes lower and stronger, and the house shows the winter: dusty baseboards, fingerprints near light switches, grime on the stovetop that was hidden by short, grey days. Plan a spring clean in November, and you will have a date and a team ready when pollen season arrives. This is how a Brazilian house cleaning in Greer works as a spring reset.

Why the method suits spring

Spring cleaning is detail work. You are not just tidying, you are cleaning the places a weekly visit rarely reaches. The Brazilian method fits because it starts from the corners. Every surface is wiped by hand, furniture and small items are moved and cleaned under, door frames and switches are detailed, and floors are washed by hand along the walls. At the end the team walks each room against a checklist.

Greer has its own spring conditions. Heavy pollen settles on sills and inside window tracks, and wet weather brings red clay onto floors near the doors. Both are the sort of thing hand work handles better than a quick pass.

A room-by-room spring plan

RoomSpring focus
KitchenDegrease the stovetop, hood and cabinet fronts, wipe the handles, clean around appliances
BathroomsGrout lines, toilet base, glass, vanity drawers
BedroomsBaseboards, closet floors, under the bed, window sills
Living areasBehind and under furniture, vents, door frames
EntryFloor edges, threshold, switches near the door

What you can do before the team arrives

  • Put away loose items from floors, counters and nightstands.
  • Wash or swap the winter bedding, so beds can be cleaned around.
  • Open blinds so the sills and tracks are visible.
  • Decide whether the pets will stay in a room or go out.
  • Make a short list of the spots that bother you, such as a stained tub or a greasy cabinet.

You do not have to clean first. The point of the visit is to do what you cannot easily do yourself, so a short list of worries is more useful than a tidied house.

How much does Brazilian house cleaning cost in Greer?

We cannot give an honest number without seeing the house, so Perfect Services only quotes after a free in-home estimate. A team member comes by, looks at your rooms and tells you the exact price. There is no commitment. These are the factors:

  • Home size: rooms and square feet.
  • Level of detail: a regular or a deep Brazilian clean.
  • Frequency: recurring visits cost less per visit.
  • Bathrooms: the most detailed rooms in the house.
  • Condition: first visits take longer.

To ask for a visit, use the form on the Greer Brazilian cleaning page, call (864) 399-5168, or text (864) 666-8520. If you want a date in March or April, an early estimate keeps it open.

Pollen, pets and allergies

Spring is when many households start sneezing, and a house full of settled pollen does not help. A few things make a difference. Window tracks collect pollen and hold it, so we clean them by hand rather than vacuuming over them. Pet hair collects at baseboards and under furniture, which is exactly where a hand-detailed clean goes. Bedding and curtains are best washed by you, and we work around them.

If anyone in the family has allergies or asthma, mention it at the estimate. We can talk about which products suit the household and which rooms to focus on first, usually the bedrooms. You can also ask us to leave out strongly scented products. We do not make health promises, but a thorough clean that removes settled dust from edges and under furniture is a sensible part of a spring routine.

One spring clean or a rhythm?

Many households start with a spring visit and then move to a recurring schedule, because the first visit takes the longest. After that the team maintains what has been cleaned, and each visit is quicker. The first clean also tells us your home's pattern, such as which bathroom gets the heaviest use and where pet hair collects. We explained how this works in Brazilian cleaning for renters in Greer, which also applies to owners.

If your spring plans include a renovation, a Brazilian house cleaning service comes after any post-construction cleaning in Greer, so the fine dust is gone first. Neighbors in Duncan can find Brazilian cleaning in Duncan with the same approach.

Perfect Services is Brazilian-owned and based in Greer, in Greenville and Spartanburg counties, ZIP codes 29650, 29651 and 29652. Our team is about ten minutes from most homes along I-85, SC-14 and US-29. To plan your spring clean, send the details through the free estimate form, and we will schedule the walk-through.

A note on timing within the season. Early spring, before the heaviest pollen, is good for the deep work, because the house will not collect as much settled dust afterward. If you prefer to wait until the trees have finished, a second lighter visit in late spring can catch what came in with open windows. Many families do both: a thorough first clean, then a recurring schedule that fits the household, whether weekly, every other week or monthly.

Whatever you choose, the estimate visit comes first. We look at the rooms, talk through pets, kids and sensitive surfaces, and agree on a plan. If the plan changes later, tell us and we adjust it. There is nothing to sign at the estimate, and the price we give is the price for the visit we have discussed.
faqs: Is it too early to plan a spring cleaning in November?
Not at all. The estimate is free, and scheduling early means you can choose a date before pollen season gets busy.
Do I need to clean before the team comes?
No. The team does the detailed work you cannot easily do yourself. Clearing floors and counters of loose items is enough.
How long does the first Brazilian clean take?
It depends on the size and condition of the home. The first visit takes longer than later ones, and the estimate gives you a clearer idea.
